2608.20913.title: Explainable Deepfake Detection with Feature-robust Augmentation and Evidence-grounded Explanation Optimization
2608.20913.paper_summary: Explainable deepfake detection extends binary classification by requiring models to not only predict authenticity but also provide interpretable justifications. This expanded scope is critical in practice, where users like forensic analysts need insight into the rationale behind the detection. Despite advancements, current approaches suffer from two critical deficiencies: (1)vulnerability to image quality degradation: detection accuracy plummets on low-quality samples, while naive augmentation strategies may induce feature drift and impair performance as diversity expands. (2) factually flawed explanations: explanation models may omit manipulation evidence or hallucinate irrelevant details, undermining interpretability. To address it, we propose a framework with two innovations. For robust deepfake detection, we introduce Feature-robust Augmentation, which comprises diversified degradation-aware augmentation strategies, and a supervised contrastive learning pattern paired with a mean-teacher architecture that stabilizes features against augmentations through consistency constraints. For explanation, we devise an evidence-grounded preference optimization process that guides model to prioritize genuine manipulation traces by learning from chosen-rejected explanation pairs, where rejected samples are constructed via evidence omission or irrelevant information injection. The proposed approach wins the first place in ACM Multimedia 2026 Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge.The code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/EDD.git.
2608.20913.paper_summary_zh: 可解釋的深偽檢測擴展了二元分類，要求模型不僅預測真實性，還提供可解釋的理由。這一擴展範疇在實踐中至關重要，因為像法醫分析師這樣的用戶需要了解檢測背後的理由。儘管已有進展，當前的方法仍存在兩個關鍵缺陷：（1）對圖像質量下降的脆弱性：在低質量樣本上，檢測準確性驟降，而天真的增強策略可能會導致特徵漂移並隨著多樣性的擴展而損害性能。（2）事實上有缺陷的解釋：解釋模型可能會省略操控證據或幻想不相關的細節，從而削弱可解釋性。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了一個具有兩項創新框架。為了實現穩健的深偽檢測，我們引入了特徵穩健增強，這包括多樣化的降質感知增強策略，並配合一種監督對比學習模式，與均值教師架構配對，通過一致性約束穩定特徵以抵抗增強。為了解釋，我們設計了一個基於證據的偏好優化過程，指導模型優先考慮真實的操控痕跡，通過從選擇-拒絕的解釋對中學習，其中拒絕的樣本是通過省略證據或注入不相關信息構建的。所提出的方法在ACM Multimedia 2026可解釋深偽檢測挑戰賽中獲得第一名。代碼可在 https://github.com/oceanflowlab/EDD.git 獲得。
